tools.name: change_request
tools.title: Change request
tools.description: Cancel or move a Kamchatka tour request by its status key when the person asks; the call returns a Vedar link, the person confirms there. Key from create_booking_request; call only when the person asked. The call changes nothing: give the person confirm_url; only their click on the Vedar page changes the request. Then: operator has not answered yet — cancelled or moved at once; already answered, booked or agreed — a request goes to the operator, who decides. A request is not a booking. A cancelled request cannot be restored. Moves only to a date with seats for everyone (get_tour_availability), at most three a day. A repeat-call key or another request's key cannot change it. Pass outcome, changed and told to the person as is.

key.description: Status key from the create_booking_request reply that created the request, as is (20–120 characters).

action.description: cancel to cancel the request; change_date to move it to the date in the date field.

date.description: New tour date, YYYY-MM-DD; required for change_date.

test.description: true for a dry run: the reply says what would happen; nothing is changed or sent.

tools.name: compare_tours
tools.title: Compare tours
tools.description: Side-by-side facts for 2-4 Kamchatka tours on what the user cares about: price or group total, duration, dates, inclusions, cancellation, pickup, operator. No ranking; one tour: get_tour_details. One row per criterion, from the database; tours in the order the person named them. Rows say only same, differs or not comparable (not recorded): never name the best tour, the person chooses. A title shared by several companies, or a seller's name, returns IDs instead of a comparison: ask the person. Tours not on the showcase are not compared.

tours.description: Two to four tours in the order the user named them: numeric IDs separated by commas (most reliable; from get_tours, get_place_info, get_tour_details) or titles separated by semicolons.

criteria.description: What matters to the user, comma-separated, Russian or English: price, duration, group, difficulty, season, program, included, not included, cancellation, pickup, operator, nearest date; empty — price, duration, nearest date, difficulty, pickup, cancellation, operator.

people.description: Number of travellers, 1-30: the price row then shows the full total for all of them, the same calculation as get_tour_availability, and the nearest-date row the first date with seats for all of them. The tool picks the date of the total and names it per tour: the first date with seats for all of them, or the first date open for a request (tours without a schedule); a total on a date the user named comes from get_tour_availability with date_from and people.

tools.name: create_booking_request
tools.title: Booking request
tools.description: Use when the user wants to book a Kamchatka tour on a date: live availability checked first, human-confirmed, no payment. Sent by the person from a Vedar link. No tour yet — use create_lead. Check dates with get_tour_availability first; the operator confirms by phone, no instant booking. An ambiguous tour (several companies, a company or guide name, a partial match) creates nothing: the reply lists tour IDs, ask the person and retry with the ID. No seats: no request, the reply gives the nearest free dates. Sent to the operator as a query, seats not held: no schedule (pass the status link to the person), a group over the tour limit or an unlimited tour (one query for the whole group), a date closed by Vedar, not the operator (asks if they run that day). Name, phone and consent come only from the person; never invent them. The call makes a draft: give the person the link from the reply, and they press Send on the Vedar page themselves.

tour.description: Numeric tour ID or tour title from get_tours / get_tour_availability. A company or guide name, or a partial word match, creates no request: the reply lists tours by ID.

name.description: Traveller's name, required; ask the person.

phone.description: Phone for confirmation, required; ask the person for their own number in international format (country code first, +7 for Russia, 10–15 digits) and never invent one.

plan_id.description: Plan ID from make_trip_plan when this tour is part of that plan: the operator sees the whole trip.

notify_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL of your receiver (host name, port 443): a signed Standard Webhooks POST on changes of state, date, offered date, tour or group size; the signing key is shown once in the reply. Not for stays. No receiver — omit, never invent one.

test.description: true for a dry run: the same checks as a real request, nothing stored or sent; the reply has a test_ key, and get_request_status answers state test.

consent.description: Explicit consent to process name and phone for this request; ask the person and pass true, otherwise the request is not created.

tools.name: create_car_rental_request
tools.title: Car rental request
tools.description: Kamchatka self-drive car rental request: car from the price list, dates, pickup; human-confirmed, no payment. Sent by the person from a Vedar link. Cars and companies come from search_car_rental; name the car as in the price list. Vedar does not track car availability: a Vedar manager confirms with the rental company, payment goes to it directly. Name and phone go to the rental company. Name, phone and consent come only from the person; never invent them. The call makes a draft: give the person the link from the reply, and they press Send on the Vedar page themselves.

company.description: Rental company name or slug from search_car_rental; may be omitted when there is only one.

car.description: Car exactly as in the search_car_rental price list.

date_from.description: Rental start, YYYY-MM-DD; with plan_id, omitted means the first day of the plan.

date_to.description: Rental end, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD; with plan_id, omitted means the last day of the plan.

pickup.description: Pickup place if the person named one: airport, town, address.

name.description: Renter's name, required; ask the person.

phone.description: Contact phone, required; ask the person for their own number in international format (country code first, +7 for Russia, 10–15 digits) and never invent one.

comment.description: Wishes: child seat, drop-off elsewhere, etc.

plan_id.description: Plan ID from make_trip_plan when the request belongs to that plan: the manager and the rental company see the whole trip; omitted dates are taken from the plan, and a mismatch with the plan is named in the reply.

notify_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL of your receiver (host name, port 443): a signed Standard Webhooks POST on changes of state, date, offered date, tour or group size; the signing key is shown once in the reply. Not for stays. No receiver — omit, never invent one.

test.description: true for a dry run: the same checks as a real request, nothing stored or sent; the reply has a test_ key, and get_request_status answers state test.

consent.description: Explicit consent to process name and phone and pass them to the rental company; ask the person and pass true, otherwise the request is not created.

tools.name: create_lead
tools.title: Tour request
tools.description: Tour-selection request for Kamchatka when no tour or date is chosen yet; human-confirmed, no payment. Sent by the person from a Vedar link. Whole-vehicle charter: request_charter. A Vedar manager calls back. Partner tour operators see the request, and it may reach several. Name, phone and consent come only from the person; never invent them. The call makes a draft: give the person the link from the reply, and they press Send on the Vedar page themselves.

name.description: Traveller's name, required; ask the person.

phone.description: Contact phone, required; ask the person for their own number in international format (country code first, +7 for Russia, 10–15 digits) and never invent one.

comment.description: The request: dates, group size, interests.

interest.description: Tour or route name, if already chosen.

plan_id.description: Plan ID from make_trip_plan when the request is for that plan: the manager gets the whole plan (group, tours by day, estimate).

notify_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL of your receiver (host name, port 443): a signed Standard Webhooks POST on changes of state, date, offered date, tour or group size; the signing key is shown once in the reply. Not for stays. No receiver — omit, never invent one.

test.description: true for a dry run: the same checks as a real request, nothing stored or sent; the reply has a test_ key, and get_request_status answers state test.

consent.description: Explicit consent to process name and phone and pass them to Vedar's partner tour operators (the request has no named operator and may reach several); ask the person and pass true, otherwise the request is not created.

tools.name: create_stay_request
tools.title: Stay request
tools.description: Kamchatka stay request: dates and guests go to the owner, human-confirmed by the owner, no payment. Sent by the person from a Vedar link. For tours use create_booking_request. Stay from search_accommodations (name or ID from its card link). The owner gets it by messenger, calls back and confirms dates and price; stays are not paid through Vedar. Only stays without own rooms on the platform or a booking site accept it; for others the reply says where to book. Name and phone go to the stay owner. Name, phone and consent come only from the person; never invent them. The call makes a draft: give the person the link from the reply, and they press Send on the Vedar page themselves.

accommodation.description: Stay name or ID from search_accommodations.

check_in.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD; with plan_id, omitted means the first day of the plan.

check_out.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD, after check-in, at most 60 nights; with plan_id, omitted means the last day of the plan.

guests.description: Number of guests, 1–50; default from the plan, otherwise 1.

name.description: Guest's name, required; ask the person.

phone.description: Phone the owner will call back, required; ask the person for their own number in international format (country code first, +7 for Russia, 10–15 digits) and never invent one.

plan_id.description: Plan ID from make_trip_plan when the request belongs to that plan: the owner sees the whole trip; omitted dates and guests are taken from the plan, and a mismatch with the plan is named in the reply.

test.description: true for a dry run: the same checks as a real request, nothing stored or sent; the reply has a test_ key, and get_request_status answers state test.

consent.description: Explicit consent to process name and phone and pass them to the stay's owner; ask the person and pass true, otherwise the request is not created.

tools.name: create_trip_request
tools.title: Trip request
tools.description: Whole Kamchatka trip in one request: tour + stay + charter vehicle under one trip id; each partner sees the rest. Human-confirmed, no payment. Sent by the person from a Vedar link. Pass at least one part: tour + tour_date, stay + check_in + check_out, or transfer_destination + transfer_date. Each part goes to its partner (tour operator, stay owner, manager with carrier); no carrier named — a Vedar manager picks one. Name, phone and consent come only from the person; never invent them. The call makes a draft: give the person the link from the reply, and they press Send on the Vedar page themselves.

participants.description: Number of people in the trip; aliases guests, passengers, participants_count, guest_count are accepted.

tour.description: Tour ID or name from get_tours.

stay.description: Stay name or ID from search_accommodations.

transfer_date_to.description: Last day of the charter, YYYY-MM-DD, if several days.

carrier.description: Carrier name from search_transfers; omit and a Vedar manager picks one.

name.description: Traveller's name, required; ask the person.

phone.description: Phone partners will call back, required; ask the person for their own number in international format (country code first, +7 for Russia, 10–15 digits) and never invent one.

comment.description: Wishes for all partners of the trip.

plan_id.description: Plan ID from make_trip_plan when the trip follows that plan: every part carries the plan; omitted people, tour date (for a tour ID from the plan) and stay dates are taken from the plan.

notify_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL of your receiver (host name, port 443): a signed Standard Webhooks POST on changes of state, date, offered date, tour or group size; the signing key is shown once in the reply. Not for stays. No receiver — omit, never invent one.

test.description: true for a dry run: the same checks as a real request, nothing stored or sent; the reply has a test_ key, and get_request_status answers state test.

consent.description: Explicit consent to process name and phone and pass them to every partner of the trip; pass true, otherwise refused.

tools.name: edit_trip_plan
tools.title: Edit trip plan
tools.description: Edit a Kamchatka trip plan from make_trip_plan by its ID: add, remove, move or replace a day, change lodging or group, shift the whole trip, apply a flight delay; untouched days stay. Tours whose date or group changed get seats and price re-read; a date shift also re-reads park closures and MChS reports. An impossible edit (arrival day, activity not for the children's age, out of season, no solution) is refused with the reason and the plan stays. Plans live 7 days; no plan — call make_trip_plan first.

plan_id.description: Plan ID from the make_trip_plan answer.

action.description: add_day (a day with an activity), remove_day, move_day, replace_day (another activity that day), set_lodging, set_party (group), shift_dates (the whole trip) or flight_delay (only when the person says the flight is delayed).

day.description: Day number in the plan, for remove_day, move_day and replace_day.

to_day.description: New position of the day, for move_day.

interest.description: Activity for add_day and replace_day, free text (Russian works best).

lodging.description: Lodging level for set_lodging: economy (camps, hostels, tents), comfort (hotels, apartments) or premium (lodges).

delay_days.description: For flight_delay: how many days the arrival flight is delayed, 1–7.

keep_return.description: For flight_delay: yes keeps the return date and shortens the trip (default); no shifts the whole trip.

adults.description: For set_party: number of adults, 1–30; omitted keeps the current number.

children.description: For set_party: age of each child in years — NOT a count ("6, 10" or [6, 10]; a baby under one — "0 years" or [0]); "no" removes the children; omitted keeps the current children. An activity too young for the youngest child is a refusal naming the days.

start_date.description: For shift_dates: the new first day of the trip, by the Kamchatka calendar — YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, or a day or month in Russian words; the trip keeps its length.

shift_days.description: For shift_dates without start_date: how many days to move the trip, signed — 7 is a week later, -3 is three days earlier.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch (ChatGPT connector)
tools.description: Full text of one Vedar Kamchatka record by id from search (tour, place, stay, route): description, price, program, safety facts; route: dated go/caution/no call, permit terms. Published records only. A place lists every tour offer with its company, ordered by the platform rule stated in the reply. A route call holds for its stated date only; ask again after it. A record not on the showcase is refused with the reason.

id.description: Record id from search: tour:<id>, place:<slug>, stay:<uuid> or route:<slug>.

tools.name: get_guardian_context
tools.title: Place safety
tools.description: Kamchatka safety context for a place or route: place status, hazards, active alerts; a catalog route with no place record gets today's go/caution/no call and park permit terms. Facts: get_place_info. Also live KB GS RAS alerts, crowding and local knowledge. The route call (go / caution / not today) has its reason and matches the route card; permit terms are as recorded. With only a similar route name, it is named as an inexact match. Always use it for a specific place, volcano, lake, route or hot spring.

tools.name: get_place_info
tools.title: Place info
tools.description: Kamchatka place facts on record: type, coordinates, altitude, hazards, distance to medical help, satellite comms, MChS registration, tours by company. No live alerts — use get_guardian_context. Gives the place page URL (share it when asked for a link or coordinates) and every tour offer with its company, ordered by the platform rule stated in the reply. No such place but a catalog route: the route, its data and park permit terms; a similar route name comes as a hint.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.title: Request status
tools.description: Kamchatka request status by key from create_lead, create_booking_request, create_stay_request, request_charter, create_car_rental_request, create_trip_request. No client name or phone. A trip has a key per part. Each key lives 90 days; without it there is no status. page is the person's request page: they confirm consent there and see replies. Pass the operator's, carrier's or rental company's reply to the person yourself: once read by the key from the request, it counts as delivered, and Vedar will not tell them again. date is the current date, requested_date the one asked for; if they differ, the booking was moved. notify shows whether the notify_url subscription is alive.

key.description: Status key from the reply of the writing tool, as is (20–120 characters).

tools.name: get_tour_availability
tools.title: Tour availability
tools.description: Use when the user asks if a Kamchatka tour has free seats: live availability by date, free seats and nearest open dates. Then booking via create_booking_request. Never give dates or seats from memory, only from here. If the window has no seats, the reply names the nearest free date after it (within a year) and, when the window does not start today, before it.

tour.description: Tour title, keyword or numeric ID from get_tours. A company or guide name returns their tour list without dates — then ask by tour ID.

date_from.description: Start of the window, a real YYYY-MM-DD in Asia/Kamchatka; default today. An invalid date is an error, not today.

people.description: Number of travellers, 1–30. When given, each date shows the full booking total — the same calculation the booking itself uses; if the window has no seats, the nearest date with seats for all of them.

tools.name: get_tour_details
tools.title: Tour details
tools.description: One Kamchatka tour in depth: program, what is included, what to bring, safety notes. A company or guide name returns a tour list and their page instead. To list or search tours use get_tours. Always use it for questions about a specific tour (program, meeting point, pickup, what to bring); never invent these details. A generic or partial company name also lists other companies' tours with those words. If only some words matched, the reply says so: do not call those tours a match.

name.description: Tour title, numeric ID, a keyword, or the name of a company or guide selling tours (the reply then lists tours and their page, not one tour).

tools.name: get_tours
tools.title: Tour catalogue
tools.description: Use when the user asks about Kamchatka (Russia) tours: operator tours with prices and dates; live availability via get_tour_availability. One tour in depth: get_tour_details. Each tour names its company. The order is a platform rule stated in the reply (free seats on the nearest date first, the rest shuffled daily), not a recommendation.

activity_type.description: Activity filter, free text (Russian works best): fishing, volcanoes, bears, geysers, trekking. Matches the activity type and the word in the tour title, place, short description or main place; tours that have the word only in the full description or programme come in a separate unverified block (check them with get_tour_details); company and guide names are not searched.

page.description: Catalogue page, 7 tours each, starting at 1; the reply ends with the page count and the next page.

tools.name: get_volcano_status
tools.title: Volcano status
tools.description: Use when the user asks about Kamchatka volcano activity: KVERT aviation code and KB GS RAS seismicity. No name — all elevated. One place or route: get_guardian_context. KVERT is the ash code, KB GS RAS the seismicity summary. With a name: that volcano on both scales.

volcano.description: Volcano name; empty — all volcanoes elevated on either scale.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.title: Weather
tools.description: Daily weather forecast (Open-Meteo) for a Kamchatka place by name, or for any point by latitude/longitude. No arguments means Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky; mountain weather differs, so name the place.

place.description: Place name as the person said it, matched in the platform directory (Russian works best).

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, from the question or another tool's reply; use together with lng. Coordinates take precedence over place.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees; use together with lat.

tools.name: make_trip_plan
tools.title: Trip plan
tools.description: Day-by-day Kamchatka trip plan with live availability and season warnings; returns a plan ID for edit_trip_plan. No forecast: use get_weather. The plan price counts only operator tours and the chosen lodging; other items have no sum, and the reply says who quotes them. The reply links the plan page (tour requests there) and, if found, a similar sample plan (built for two adults on its own dates). Day, lodging, group, date or flight-delay changes: edit_trip_plan with the ID. Other interests or style: call make_trip_plan again with the same arguments plus the change.

days.description: Trip length in days, 3–21; default — the length of a date range in when (10–17 July is 8 days), otherwise 7.

interests.description: Interests in the person's own words.

when.description: When the trip starts, by the Kamchatka calendar: a month or a day in Russian words, DD.MM.YYYY, a range of days (10–17 July) or YYYY-MM-DD; today and tomorrow are Kamchatka time. Season decides what is possible: always pass the month or dates the person gave. Default is one month from today. Text that is not a date, or a day that does not exist (2027-02-30), is an error and no plan is built: ask the person.

travel_style.description: How the traveller wants to go: self (no guide, only where our safety data allows), operator (operator tours) or mixed; default mixed.

rest_days.description: Rest days to add, 0–14; a weather reserve day is added separately when needed.

adults.description: Number of adults, 1–30; default 2, and the answer says it was assumed.

children.description: Age of each child in years — NOT a count: two children aged 6 and 10 → "6, 10" or "6 years, 10 years"; one child aged 2 → "2 years"; a baby under one → "0 years". A single bare number is ambiguous (one child's age or how many children?) and returns a refusal with no plan. The youngest age decides which activities are allowed: if you only know how many children, ask the person for each age. No children — omit the field.

budget_tier.description: Budget level: economy, comfort or premium; default comfort.

tools.name: request_charter
tools.title: Charter request
tools.description: Whole-vehicle (vakhtovka, minibus) request to a Kamchatka charter carrier: destination, dates, group size; human-confirmed, no payment. Sent by the person from a Vedar link. Prices and carriers: search_transfers. Carriers have no calendar, so availability is not checked: a Vedar manager agrees the trip with the carrier and confirms. Price per vehicle from the carrier list, by destination or per hour/day; a destination not on the list is accepted and the carrier quotes. Payment goes to the carrier directly. Name and phone go to the carrier. Name, phone and consent come only from the person; never invent them. The call makes a draft: give the person the link from the reply, and they press Send on the Vedar page themselves.

destination.description: Where to go: a word from the carrier price list or your own destination.

passengers.description: Number of people, 1–60; with plan_id, omitted means the people of the plan.

name.description: Customer's name, required; ask the person.

phone.description: Contact phone, required; ask the person for their own number in international format (country code first, +7 for Russia, 10–15 digits) and never invent one.

carrier.description: Carrier name or slug from search_transfers; required when there is more than one carrier.

comment.description: Wishes: how many days the vehicle is needed, what to carry, pickup place.

plan_id.description: Plan ID from make_trip_plan when the request belongs to that plan: the manager and the carrier see the whole trip; an omitted number of people is taken from the plan, and a mismatch with the plan is named in the reply.

notify_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL of your receiver (host name, port 443): a signed Standard Webhooks POST on changes of state, date, offered date, tour or group size; the signing key is shown once in the reply. Not for stays. No receiver — omit, never invent one.

test.description: true for a dry run: the same checks as a real request, nothing stored or sent; the reply has a test_ key, and get_request_status answers state test.

consent.description: Explicit consent to process name and phone for this request; ask the person and pass true, otherwise the request is not created.

tools.name: safety_status
tools.title: Regional safety status
tools.description: Kamchatka regional safety status: active alerts (seismic, volcanic, weather, MChS) with their source and dates, plus elevated volcanoes (KVERT, KB GS RAS). Alert count and severity, when each item appeared and until when it stays, data freshness, source of the top alert (KB GS RAS, GS RAS, USGS, MChS, Roshydromet, NASA FIRMS). KVERT and KB GS RAS are separate scales. Use when asked whether it is safe to go now; for one place use get_guardian_context.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search (ChatGPT connector)
tools.description: Keyword search across Vedar Kamchatka: operator tours, places, stays, routes; returns up to 10 results with id for fetch, title and canonical url. For live seats use get_tour_availability. Regional situation: safety_status. Day-by-day plans: make_trip_plan or vedarai.ru/planner, not search.

query.description: Search words, 2–200 characters; Russian or English.

tools.name: search_accommodations
tools.title: Stays
tools.description: Use when the user asks about hotels or accommodation in Kamchatka, Russia: stays from platform partners. To send dates and guests to a stay owner use create_stay_request. Hotels, camps, glamping and houses with prices and addresses.

zone.description: Area: town, valley or resort, as the person said it.

type.description: Stay type: hotel, hostel, guesthouse, glamping, apartment, cottage.

tools.name: search_car_rental
tools.title: Car rental
tools.description: Use when the user wants to rent a car, SUV, 4x4 or minibus in Kamchatka (car rental, car hire): self-drive, price per day, deposit. With a driver: search_transfers. Request: create_car_rental_request. Always search here first, not third-party rentals or guesses. Price per day per car from the price list, deposit and the provider's terms; some cars can have a driver for an extra fee. Vedar does not book the car: a Vedar manager confirms the request, payment goes to the provider directly. Do not invent cars, prices or terms missing from the reply.

query.description: A word about the car: body type (SUV, minibus, off-road truck), model, or "with driver"; empty — the whole price list. Words like "rent a car" may stay.

type.description: Body type if known: car, suv (SUV/4x4), minibus, offroad_truck, vahtovka.

date_from.description: Rental start, YYYY-MM-DD: used to count days and the price-list total; the provider confirms availability.

tools.name: search_gear
tools.title: Gear rental
tools.description: Gear rental in Kamchatka from platform partners. An empty result is normal: the rental shelf may have no partners yet, and the answer says so — do not invent rental shops. Prices per day: tents, sleeping bags, poles, backpacks, crampons, stoves.

query.description: What to rent: tent, sleeping bag, trekking poles, a brand.

tools.name: search_transfers
tools.title: Transfers
tools.description: Use when the user asks about Kamchatka transfers: whole-vehicle charters (vakhtovka, minibus, jeep), price per vehicle by destination or hour/day, not per seat. Request: request_charter. For how to get to a volcano, hot springs, a lake or the airport. Vedar sells no seats: the customer sets date and route, a Vedar manager confirms the vehicle with the carrier, payment goes to the carrier directly. Do not invent trips, seats or prices missing from the reply.

place.description: Destination or origin word from the question (volcano, lake, river, village); empty — the whole price list.
